name: logic-map-workspace
description: Turn your codebase into a logic map.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @logic-map/schema && npm run build -w @logic-map/typescript && npm run build -w @logic-map/logic-compiler && npm run build -w @logic-map/core && npm run build -w @logic-map/viewer && npm run build -w logic-map
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm audit --audit-level=high && node scripts/check-package.mjs
